messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 13):
"""
Insurers shall ensure that the payments are made to the TPAs only after availing the services and upon full discharge of services by the TPA satisfactorily. C. Product Management Committee and Advertisement Committee I. Product Management Committee(PMC): 1. The PMC shall ensure: a. that all the matters referred under regulation 6(1)(b) of IRDAI (Insurance Products) Regulations, 2024 are complied with; b. compliance with circulars, guidance, if any, issued / communicated by the Competent Authority; c. that the benefits reflecting in sales literature, terms and conditions reflecting in policy document shall be consistent with the design approved; 2. The PMC shall be constituted with Appointed Actuary (AA), Chief Marketing / Distribution Officer, Chief Investment Officer, Chief Technology Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer of the Insurer as members.
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who must be a member of the Product Management Committee as per the IRDAI circular?","answer":"The Product Management Committee must include the Appointed Actuary, Chief Marketing/Distribution Officer, Chief Investment Officer, Chief Technology Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer of the insurer.","facts":["\"The PMC shall be constituted with Appointed Actuary (AA), Chief Marketing / Distribution Officer, Chief Investment Officer, Chief Technology Officer, and Chief Compliance Officer of the Insurer as members.\""]},{"question":"Under what condition must insurers pay TPAs according to the IRDAI circular?","answer":"Insurers must pay TPAs only after the services have been availed and the TPA has fully discharged the services satisfactorily.","facts":["\"Insurers shall ensure that the payments are made to the TPAs only after availing the services and upon full discharge of services by the TPA satisfactorily.\""]}]}
